intro: Work and experiments across landscapes, sculpture, medicine, archives, and the things that happen between them.
bio: Lauren Kim is an artist and researcher interested in the peculiar ways people learn to observe the world—and what happens when those ways of seeing are taken somewhere unexpected. Her work moves between archives, landscapes, medicine, and material experiments.
bio_secondary: This is an evolving index of things made independently, in collaboration, and through Hajo. Not everything here is finished, and not everything fits neatly into one category.
